title: StewardshipMetadata
description: Metadata for stewardship allocations and stewardship-context content. Stewardship standing is earned through sustained curation work (edits, reviews, dispute resolution), not granted by credential or attention.

allocationStrategy.description: How stewardship standing is distributed: equal (even split), weighted (by contribution), custodial (original creator priority)

affinityScore.description: 0.0-1.0 stewardship affinity score. Accrues from curation acts, decays via demurrage. Attention does NOT increase this — only active curation work.

custodianRole.description: The steward's role in relation to the content

circulationRights.description: What the steward can do with the content — governs reach expansion and derivative works

demurrageRate.description: Rate at which standing decays without activity (0.0-1.0 per period). Ensures stewardship requires ongoing engagement, preventing dormant capture.

eprId.description: EPR reference to the curation act

curationHistory.description: Record of curation acts that built this steward's standing
